name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Experimental surface tram terminus. Native reversal is not yet proven; test saves only.
description: Private prototype: adds a new surface tram stop with a centered internal track and one experimental bidirectional terminal. Reuses vanilla assets. Connections, routing, reversal, power and passenger access require in-game testing. No existing stations or vehicles are modified. No turning loop and no automatic reverse commands. Visuals are unfinished. Use one vehicle on a separate test save. Do not remove the mod while its constructions remain in the save; restore the original test save to undo. Based on Urban Games vanilla tram street template and station assets. Revision 2 adds a read-only network report for existing prototype stops; it does not change their geometry or repair routing.
